name: nfet_level_shift
summary: One N-MOSFET and a pull-up: a logic output shifted up to another rail, inverted
note: The input drives the gate; the drain is pulled up to VOUT. It inverts (input high pulls the output low), so firmware sends the complement: the RP2350 can invert a pin's output in hardware (GPIO OUTOVER). The bolt earring drives its LED chains like this, with 1 kohm pull-ups. The output's high is VOUT through the pull-up: its rise time is the pull-up times the line's capacitance, so keep the pull-up small for fast data (800 kHz LED data wants well under 1 us).

Q1.note: 1 gate, 2 source, 3 drain, as KiCad's BSS138 symbol
